categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in steel manufacturing, including cold-rolled steel coils, galvanized steel coils, aluminized steel coils, and painted steel coils. It also engages in steel processing, metal forging, heat treatment, surface treatment, wholesale, international trade, and consulting services related to steel products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical analysis and coating technologies, including low-temperature baking painted steel with reduced gas consumption and carbon emissions, sulfurized copper-patterned painted steel, bio-based environmentally friendly painted steel, and matte color series for home appliances. It employs precise production processes for cold rolling, galvanizing, aluminizing, and painting steel coils, supported by ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certified management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as construction, home appliances, hardware, automotive, machinery, and energy sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, focusing on high-quality steel products for building materials, solar panel supports, and appliance shells. Major export markets include North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung. It has subsidiaries and investments in China (Hefei), Hong Kong, Seychelles, and Dongguan, China. Sales cover domestic Taiwan markets and export markets in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on steel processing and finishing. It sources raw materials such as hot-rolled steel coils, zinc, and aluminum ingots from upstream suppliers and supplies processed steel products downstream to manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, expanding market share, digital transformation, and sustainability. R&D focuses on developing low-temperature baking painted steel, environmentally friendly bio-based coatings, advanced decorative coatings, and high-durability weather-resistant painted steel. The company also emphasizes reducing carbon emissions and energy consumption in production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of steel products including galvanized, aluminized, cold-rolled, and painted steel coils. The company also earns income from processing services, technical support contracts, and international trade activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a challenging steel market with overcapacity issues, especially from China. It positions itself as a high-quality steel producer with strong brand recognition in Taiwan and selected overseas markets. Competitors include other regional steel manufacturers and global steel producers with cost and quality competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$13.69 billion, a 10.5% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$590 million. The company maintains a strong equity ratio of about 89.3% and has shown stable operational cash flow despite market challenges. It has a workforce with an average training of 30 hours per employee annually and invests significantly in R&D and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly steel products with advanced coating technologies that reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions. It offers differentiated products such as low-temperature baked painted steel and decorative patterned steel with superior chemical resistance. Strong customer service, flexible production, and a robust brand contribute to its competitive advantage.
